module: Flowgraph node "Countdown" (tag scenario). Manages a countdown displayed on screen via the ScenarioFlashMessage hook (and Message if data.useMessages). Input pins: flow, reset (pulse), duration (3 s by default), countdownMsg (hidden, '%d'), finishMsg ('Go!'), finishMsgDuration (hidden, 1 s). Outputs: flow (true once finished), finished (pulse), ongoing (in progress). The countdown starts when flow is active, and uses mgr.dtSim.
notes: data.playSounds (true by default) plays UI_Countdown1 every second and UI_CountdownGo at the end.
If core_flowgraphManager.skipCountdowns is true, the timer starts at 0 (immediate end).
If finishMsg is nil, the message is the translation key "ui.scenarios.go".

init.desc: Initializes the data options (useImgui, useMessages, playSounds, bigFinishMsg) and the state.

onExecutionStarted.desc: Resets duration, timer and message to defaults.

reset.desc: Stops the countdown and resets the outputs to false.

stopTimer.desc: Stops the timer and clears done and flags.

startTimer.desc: Reads the duration, arms the timer, clears the previous flash message and starts.

show.desc: Displays a flash message (ScenarioFlashMessage), and a Message if data.useMessages.

duration.desc: Duration in s (1.4 large, 0.95 small by default)

luaCall.desc: Lua code executed by the UI (sound)

countdown.desc: Decrements the timer by mgr.dtSim, displays every second and signals the end.

drawMiddle.desc: Progress bar and state (Running, Done, Stopped) in the editor.

work.desc: Handles reset, starts the timer if flow is active, calls countdown and fills the outputs.
